# Expected join counts for tests/fixtures/scip_harness/corpus (ISSUES.md §5).
#
# calls_matched              graph CALLS edges found in the oracle's strict
#                            same-file free-function call set (must-match)
# calls_graph_only_referenced graph CALLS edges outside the strict set that the
#                            oracle still attests with a reference (may-exceed)
# calls_oracle_only          strict-set oracle edges absent from the graph
# imports                    IMPORTS edges in the graph
#
# There is no key for fabricated edges (graph CALLS edges the oracle has no
# reference for): scripts/scip-harness-join.py rejects them unconditionally.
calls_matched=5
calls_graph_only_referenced=1
calls_oracle_only=0
imports=3
